summary: Motorola Solutions filed an 8-K reporting the closing of an underwritten public offering of $950 million aggregate principal amount of senior notes: $350 million 4.850% notes due 2029 and $600 million 5.650% notes due 2036. The notes were issued under an existing indenture and sold via an underwriting agreement dated August 6, 2026. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation. No change of control, restructuring, or strategic event is involved. The filing is purely informational and does not trigger any special-situation analysis or risk-arbitrage angle.
